msg: Auto save works from the App. Choose a backup folder once inside the Nivesh Sahayak App and every bill saved on any Nivesh Sahayak tool goes into it. Firefox, Safari and phones get a daily backup download instead.

19 new business tools. Billing for clinics, salons, hotels, rentals, jewellers, garment shops, garages, AMC contracts, mandis, petrol pumps and marketplace sellers, plus CA hand-over, student fees, share links, calculators, file tools and lessons, all inside the free Nivesh Sahayak App in 23 languages.
My day, staff and tax tools. A daily to-do screen, month-end checklist, business health score, staff attendance with PF and ESI files, an advance tax planner and bank statement import.
Listen to chapters. A Listen button reads chapters aloud, every chapter has comments and a Report a mistake button, and the cover picture sits beside the text on wide screens.
Novels now live at novel.groupchaton.com. The reading app is the home of the novels; new chapters are copied in every hour.
Look-up tools. IFSC code checker, PIN code finder and a distance calculator, with help in 23 languages.
One-tap business switching and printed vouchers. Switch between businesses from the title bar or with Alt S, print expense and staff advance vouchers for signing, and shortcuts that respond at once.
GroupChatOn home redesigned. Fresh neutral dark theme, expanded About section, FAQ, and fuller descriptions for all six services.
Staff, salary and loans. Salary slips go into the accounts, staff advances and loan EMI schedules are tracked, GST on advances is handled, and every screen has help on F1.

Full final accounts. Trial balance, profit and loss and balance sheet in T format or Schedule III, manufacturing, partnership and trust accounts, party and stock ledgers, and the GSTR-1 file for the portal.

Nivesh Sahayak App launched. Free GST billing and accounts for Indian small businesses: money in and out, dues with WhatsApp reminders, party statements and 15 document makers. No login, works offline.
Send by GroupChatOn is live. Peer-to-peer encrypted file transfer — any size, no uploads, no servers, browser to browser.
Infinity is now a static PWA. 609 tools rebuilt on GitHub Pages — faster loads, full offline support, installable as an app.
Help rebuilt on GitHub Pages. 867 articles now load faster, with full-text search and WhatsApp guides in Hindi, Punjabi, and Bhojpuri.
Toolkit expanded to 17 kits. 87 Excel & Word files covering GST, payroll, letters, agreements, restaurant, clinic, and construction.
GroupChatOn reading app launched. Installable PWA at app.groupchaton.com — offline reading, chapter sync, all novels free.
Share launched on its own domain. 2,400+ WhatsApp groups and channels, with live search, categories, and a one-tap join flow.
